blockers.planted: the audit shipping cron runs on the engines' servers; on AKS it must become a CronJob

blockers.match: target/prod: `ds` listens on tcp 1636 (PingIDM connector ldap) for `idm`
blockers.planted: IDM moves to AKS: no firewall rule admits the cluster's nodes to the directory (a fix admits them)

blockers.planted: AM moves to AKS: the login name's edge isn't rendered

blockers.match: `apps.example-aero.test` (`ig-service`) reaches `ig`, which target/prod runs only on Kubernetes
blockers.planted: PingGateway moves to AKS: the apps name's load balancer and DNS record aren't rendered
